messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary deployment failed for service model-server in cluster prod-us-east. 503 spike > 30% across canary pods. Image tag: prod-20260310. Notifying #incidents and paging oncall.

ci-bot: Buildkite build 9876 -> image gcr.io/redwood-inference/model-server:prod-20260310 pushed. No immediate build errors. Hash: sha256:abcd1234.

maria (oncall): Paging in. I'm looking at the canary dashboard, 5 of 8 canary pods returning 503. App logs show "failed to load model shard" errors. Mount/IO? Any recent infra changes?

jen (sre): I'm seeing a mix of stack traces referencing model binary v2.1 but we expected v2.2. Can you dump the pod images?

josh (deploy): running quick check:
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -l rollouts=canary -o=jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name} {.spec.containers[0].image}{"\\n"}{end}'
```
output: 
```
model-server-canary-1 gcr.io/redwood-inference/model-server:prod-20260309
model-server-canary-2 gcr.io/redwood-inference/model-server:prod-20260309
model-server-canary-3 gcr.io/redwood-inference/model-server:prod-20260310
model-server-canary-4 gcr.io/redwood-inference/model-server:prod-20260309
```

samir (platform): huh — that shows mixed tags across the canary set. That's not normal; our rollout controller should atomically update the ReplicaSet. Could be an image pull issue or registry tag collision.

alice (release): @josh, did the rollout strategy change? Was this a blue/green or rolling? We expected a rolling update with maxSurge=1.

josh (deploy): It was rolling. Buildkite reported success and pushed prod-20260310. But I'm noticing artifact cache service (bazel-remote) had a recent eviction window. CI might have returned older layers for some nodes.

ryan (eng): Confirming: image prod-20260309 contains model binary v2.1, which isn't compatible with config for v2.2. That would explain the "failed to load model shard".

maria (oncall): Customer impact? Any externals affected? Telemetry shows increased 5xx for the inference API; error budget hit on some SLAs. Escalate to P1 and start mitigation.

jen (sre): Mitigation plan: 1) Pause rollout and mark canary as paused, 2) kill the bad pods with prod-20260310 only, 3) force canary to use stable tag prod-20260309 OR revert to the previous deployment. Which is safer?

josh (deploy): I recommend rolling back to the previous ReplicaSet (prod-20260309) cluster-wide so tags are consistent, then we can investigate CI/registry. Rolling forward might reintroduce mixed state.

samir (platform): Before rolling, we need to verify registry immutability. Querying registry: `gcloud container images describe gcr.io/redwood-inference/model-server:prod-20260310 --format='get(image_summary.digest)'` returns sha256:abcd1234. But some nodes pulled sha256:zzzz9999 (prod-20260309) while tag name pointed elsewhere during a short window. Looks like tag swap / cache poisoning during push.

ci-bot: Noting: push to gcr happened concurrently with bazel-remote GC at 03:12 UTC. Artifact layer dedup caused old layers to be referenced for new tag in some registry mirrors.

maria (oncall): Ok kill switch: enable feature-flag kill-switch for new-compiler (rollout) to stop traffic to canary. `ffctl set new-compiler false --env=prod`

jen (sre): Done. Traffic routed back to baseline by the gateway, new canary receives almost no traffic. Still need to fix node-level mixed images to avoid future restarts bringing back the wrong binary.

josh (deploy): Performing emergency rollback to ReplicaSet/rs-stable-prod-20260309 now: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/model-server --to-revision=rs-stable-prod-20260309 -n inference`

incsec-bot: Noted: rolling back. Creating audit ticket SEC-321 for image tag integrity incident.

maria (oncall): After rollback, error rate dropped back to baseline within 6 minutes. Customers: a subset of requests (approx 2.4% of requests in 10m window) saw 503s. No data loss. Logging incident for follow-up.

ryan (eng): Postmortem action items: 1) Enforce registry immutability on prod tags, 2) add CI step to verify digest pinned by digest not tag before kube rollout, 3) add atomic promotion of tag after GC windows, 4) improve rollout controller to detect mixed-image ReplicaSets and abort.

samir (platform): Short-term patch: disable concurrent GC on bazel-remote for the registry during deploy windows for next 48h and add checksum verification in our deploy pipeline.

alice (release): I'll open the release rollback notes and notify customers via status.redwood.ai with a brief: "Transient 5xx during canary due to artifact cache race; rollback completed. Investigating."

jen (sre): Handoff: I'll own the incident until postmortem. @maria handing back oncall at +2h.

maria (oncall): ack. I'll prepare a quick incident summary for the oncall log and add reactions. :white_check_mark:

josh (deploy): saving logs and images: `gcloud container images list-tags gcr.io/redwood-inference/model-server --format='get(digest,tags,uploaded)'` and upload to runbook.

ci-bot: Created CI ticket CI-452 to add digest pinning and to block pushes during GC windows.

maria (oncall): closing the paging loop. If anything regresses, re-open this thread. Great work coordinating, team. :thumbsup:

(incident-narration): timeline attached to the ticket.
